{{StoryArc|Training Montage|Those Fortunate Ones|Sunstreaker}}

'''Shining Star''' is a [[Special Mission|Spotlight Mission]] featuring [[Sunstreaker]] that ran from August 11 - 25, 2022.

== Synopsis ==
''Sunstreaker has arrived on New Quintessa, much to the delight of his twin brother Sideswipe. But not all is well within the Autobot family as Sunstreaker seems to have it out for the Commander. Will Sideswipe be able to sway his brother into falling in line with their new human friend, or will we be blinded by the rage of this SHINING STAR?''
